note: Ndebele translation of maize.json (names, signs, field checks) plus keywords for on-device retrieval. Beta: machine-drafted, needs review by a Ndebele-speaking agronomist.

entries.name: Ukuswela kwe-nitrogen
entries.signs: Ukuphuzi kuqalisa esihlokweni samahlamvu amadala angaphansi kwehlele phakathi kwehlamvu ngesimo se-V; izilimo zidanile futhi zincane.
entries.checkInField: Qathanisa amahlamvu angaphansi lawaphezulu; buza ukuthi umanyolo wafakwa nini; qathanisa lomugca owafakwa umanyolo kuhle.

entries.name: Amanzi amanengi emhlabathini
entries.signs: Ukuphuzi kumbe ukuba nsomi lokungakhuli ezindaweni ezingaphansi zesimu ngemva kwezulu elinengi; impande ezinsundu, ezimbalwa kumbe ezinuka kubi.
entries.checkInField: Khangela amanzi amileyo kumbe umhlabathi omanzi ngemva kwezulu; siphuna isilimo esisodwa ukhangele impande zibolile kumbe zinuka.

entries.name: Ukoma / ukuswela amanzi
entries.signs: Amahlamvu ayasonga abe mpunga-luhlaza, ikakhulu emini; izilimo ziyabuya ebusuku nxa inkinga incane.
entries.checkInField: Mba u-10 cm: nxa umhlabathi uhlakazeka womile, amanzi mancane. Khangela ukuthi amahlamvu ayavuleka ekuseni.

entries.name: Ukuswela kwe-sulfur
entries.signs: Amahlamvu amatsha aphezulu aphuzi wonke, ngezinye izikhathi alemigqa phakathi kwemithambo; izilimo zincane.
entries.checkInField: Qathanisa amahlamvu amatsha aphezulu lamadala angaphansi. Kuvamile emhlabathini wesihlabathi.

entries.name: Ukuswela kwe-potassium
entries.signs: Amahlamvu amadala ayaphuzi abesensundu emaphethelweni kodwa phakathi kuhlala kuluhlaza; iziqu ezibuthakathaka ziyawa.
entries.checkInField: Khangela amaphethelo amahlamvu angaphansi: ukutsha okuphuzi-nsundu kuluhlaza phakathi.

entries.name: Ukuswela kwe-phosphorus
entries.signs: Izilimo ezincane eziluhlaza okukhulu ezilamaphethelo lezihloko ezinsomi kumbe ezibomvu; ukukhula okuphuzayo ekuqaleni.
entries.checkInField: Khangela ukuthi umbala onsomi usezilimweni ezincane endaweni yonke; qathanisa lezilimo zenhlanyelo efanayo kwenye indawo.

entries.name: Ukuswela kwe-zinc
entries.signs: Imigqa ebanzi emhlophe kumbe ephuzi kancane ezinhlangothini zombili zehlamvu kumahlamvu amatsha; amalunga amafitshane.
entries.checkInField: Hlola amahlamvu amatsha: imigqa ebanzi elula eqalisa eduze kwesisekelo sehlamvu.

entries.name: Imbungu (fall armyworm)
entries.signs: Imigodi engalinganiyo lezindawo ezibonisayo emahlamvini; indle emanzi enjengothuli lwezigodo phakathi kwenhliziyo yombila; imbungu ezile-Y phezu kwekhanda.
entries.checkInField: Hamba ngesimo se-W uhlole izilimo ezingu-20: vula inhliziyo, dinga indle lembungu. Bhala ukuthi zingaki ku-20 ezilimeleyo.

entries.name: Imbungu yesiqu
entries.signs: Imigqa yemigodi emincane emahlamvini lapho evuleka; ihlamvu eliphakathi lifile; imigudu phakathi kwesiqu.
entries.checkInField: Donsa ihlamvu eliphakathi: nxa liphuma libolile ngaphansi, dabula isiqu udinge imigudu kumbe imbungu.

entries.name: Igciwane lemigqa yombila
entries.signs: Imigqa emincane ephuzi eqamukileyo eceleni kwemithambo yamahlamvu amatsha, ezihlanganayo ngemva; izilimo azikhuli nxa zithelelwe zisencane.
entries.checkInField: Phatha ihlamvu elitsha ekukhanyeni udinge imigqa emincane ephuzi eqamukileyo eceleni kwemithambo. Bala izilimo ezithintekileyo.

entries.name: Umkhuhlane obulalayo wombila (MLN)
entries.signs: Amabala aphuzi, ngemva ukoma kusukela emaphethelweni kungena phakathi; ihlamvu eliphakathi liyafa; izilimo zingafa kumbe izikhwebu zibole.
entries.checkInField: Bhala ukuthi zingaki izilimo ezoma kusukela emaphethelweni lokuthi amahlamvu aphakathi afile yini. Tshela umeluleki wezolimo.

entries.name: Amabala ampunga emahlamvini
entries.signs: Amabala amade amancane anjengebhokisi ampunga kumbe ansundu emisa emithanjeni, eqalisa emahlamvini angaphansi nxa kumanzi.
entries.checkInField: Khangela amahlamvu angaphansi: amabala anjengebhokisi alezinhlangothi eziqondileyo.

entries.name: Ukoma kwamahlamvu (northern leaf blight)
entries.signs: Amabala amade anjengogwayi kumbe isikepe, ampunga-luhlaza kumbe ansundu, akhuphuka evela phansi nxa kuqanda kumanzi.
entries.checkInField: Linganisa amabala ambalwa: amabala amade anjengeqanda (ama-cm amanengi) atshengisa i-blight.

entries.name: Isona (striga)
entries.signs: Umbila omncane, ophuzi njalo obunayo lanxa kulamanzi, lokhula oluncane olamaluba apinki kumbe ansomi phansi.
entries.checkInField: Khangela phansi kwezilimo ezithintekileyo: ukhula oluncane olamaluba apinki kumbe ansomi; mba kuhle ubone ukuthi lunamathele empandeni yini.
